statuses.demonstrated: User-facing package is exercised or explicitly instantiated in one or more live governed notebooks.
statuses.support: Support/internal package is intentionally not a standalone notebook surface; rationale must cite where it is covered or why no notebook is appropriate.
statuses.docs_tests: Package is primarily covered by library docs/tests rather than notebooks; rationale must cite the non-notebook coverage path.

admin.rationale: Profile administration supports branding/profile setup rather than a standalone notebook workflow; the branding notebook demonstrates the user-facing profile outcome.

conf.rationale: Default configuration constants support the configuration workflow demonstrated in the foundations configuration notebook.

configs.rationale: Bundled static configuration files are consumed by the configuration notebook; they are data/config assets, not a standalone API surface.

core.rationale: Core logging/string/SQL safety helpers are cross-cutting support surfaces; safe local operations are demonstrated in the file-operations notebook while direct API details remain unit-test responsibility.

development.rationale: Development architecture helpers are maintainer-facing and covered by tests/docs rather than end-user notebooks.

distributed.rationale: Distributed Spark/HDFS helpers are not directly exercised by the current governed Spark notebook, which demonstrates the engines SparkEngine surface only. Keep this explicit until a Spark-tier notebook safely exercises siege_utilities.distributed helpers such as column-name sanitization, row counts, or HDFS configuration with fixtures.

education.rationale: NCES/education readers are package functionality but do not yet have a dedicated governed notebook; coverage is tracked here explicitly until a user-facing education notebook is warranted.

examples.rationale: The examples package is non-library demonstration code; governed notebooks are the canonical example surface.

hygiene.rationale: Hygiene/docstring generation is maintainer tooling and should be covered by tests and contributor docs, not end-user notebooks.

oss_unity_catalog.rationale: OSS Unity Catalog helpers are not currently a live governed notebook surface; keep explicit until Databricks/Unity Catalog notebook coverage is expanded.

political.rationale: Current political-domain notebooks exercise survey, reporting, and geo/redistricting concepts but do not import or execute siege_utilities.political readers or schema migration helpers. Keep this explicit until a fixture-backed political reader/schema notebook is added.

schema.rationale: Schema migration runner is operational infrastructure with package tests; not a notebook capability unless a future admin/migration tutorial is added.

testing.rationale: Testing helpers support maintainers and CI; they are intentionally exercised by tests rather than notebooks.

trino.rationale: Trino federation is not currently a governed notebook surface; keep explicit until a live or fixture-backed federation notebook is added.
